from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted data for a single university from a Common Data Set document."""
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university or institution")
    average_age: float | None = Field(description="Average age of full-time undergraduate students (from Section F1)")
    first_year_admitted: float | None = Field(description="Count of first-time, first-year degree-seeking students admitted (from Section C1)")
    first_year_enrolled: float | None = Field(description="Count of first-time, first-year degree-seeking students enrolled (from Section C1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityRecord]
